USAGE:
    openapi-tool [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    openapi-tool validate ./openapi.yaml
    openapi-tool convert ./openapi.yaml --format json
    openapi-tool discover ./specs
    openapi-tool discover ./specs --format json -o results.json
    openapi-tool endpoints ./openapi.yaml

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    help                     Shows help for the application or a specific       
                             command                                            
    validate <path>          Validates an OpenAPI document against the          
                             specification                                      
    convert <path>           Converts an OpenAPI document between JSON and YAML 
    discover <path>          Recursively scans a directory and identifies       
                             OpenAPI documents by content                       
    endpoints <path>         Lists all endpoints (paths and operations) in an   
                             OpenAPI document                                   
    stats <path>             Shows overview statistics for an OpenAPI document  
    search <path> <query>    Fuzzy searches endpoints, schemas, and other       
                             components in an OpenAPI document                  
    unused <path>            Finds unused/orphaned components in an OpenAPI     
                             document                                           
    lint <spec> <config>     Lints an OpenAPI document against a configurable   
                             ruleset                                            
    diff <old> <new>         Diffs two OpenAPI documents and identifies breaking
                             changes                                            
    resolve <path>           Resolves all $ref references into a single         
                             self-contained document                            
    split <path> <output>    Splits a monolithic OpenAPI document into mult
[truncated]

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Recursively scans a directory and identifies OpenAPI documents by content.

USAGE:
    openapi-tool discover <path> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    openapi-tool discover ./specs
    openapi-tool discover ./specs --format json -o results.json

ARGUMENTS:
    <path>    Directory to scan recursively for OpenAPI documents

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                Prints help information                           
    -e, --ext <EXTENSIONS>    Comma-separated list of file extensions to        
                              consider (default: json,yaml,yml)                 
    -s, --max-size <MB>       Skip files larger than this many megabytes        
                              (default: 10)                                     
        --no-validate         Skip full parse validation; use only the cheap    
                              magic-string prefilter                            
    -f, --format <FORMAT>     Output format: table, json, yaml, plain (default: 
                              table)                                            
    -o, --output <OUTPUT>     Write results to a file instead of stdout

    openapi-tool search ./openapi.yaml pet --components schemas

    <path>     Path to the OpenAPI document
    <query>    Search query (fuzzy match)  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
    -c, --components <COMPONENTS>    Comma-separated components to search:      
                                     endpoints,schemas,parameters,responses,secu
                                     rity (default: all)                        
    -t, --threshold <THRESHOLD>      Match threshold 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.4)     
    -f, --format <FORMAT>            Output format: table, json, yaml, plain    
                                     (default: table)                           
    -o, --output <OUTPUT>            Write results to a file instead of stdout

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Merges multiple OpenAPI documents into a single unified specification.

USAGE:
    openapi-tool merge [files...] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    openapi-tool merge --title Platform API --version 1.0.0 -o merged.json 
api1.yaml api2.yaml
    openapi-tool merge --config merge.config.json

ARGUMENTS:
    [files...]    OpenAPI files to merge (required unless --config is used)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
        --config <CONFIG>               Path to a JSON merge configuration file 
    -o, --output <OUTPUT>               Output file path (default:              
                                        merged-openapi.json)                    
        --title <TITLE>                 API title for the merged specification  
        --version <VERSION>             API version for the merged specification
        --schema-conflict <STRATEGY>    Strategy for schema conflicts: rename,  
                                        first-wins, or fail (default: rename)   
    -f, --format <FORMAT>               Output format: json or yaml (default:   
                                        json)                                   
    -v, --verbose                       Show detailed progress and warnings
